pictures.author: Erwin Verbruggen
pictures.observations: Entire960x642 ordinary main facade detail inspected after loading. Orange/red close-coursed brick tower, vertical pilaster rhythms, receding stepped cornices/miniature shrines and original leaf/scroll-like corner ornament. Pointed brick entry pediment has a recessed stone relief panel above massive dark stone lintel/jambs and real dark entrance. Original simplified relief used rather than copying the deity or inscription.

pictures.author: Ms Sarah Welch
pictures.observations: Entire500x667 ordinary south-tower view inspected. Square brick body with tapered four-sided pointed pyramidal roof/small finial, vertical mouldings, projecting leaf-shaped east porch/stone jambs and lintel, recessed dark door and short brick steps. Blind side niche has stepped pointed surround. Roof/body height ratios and hidden facades approximate.

pictures.author: Tervlugt
pictures.observations: Entire500x750 ordinary smallest northwest shrine inspected. Projecting pointed entry pediment/real dark rectangular door; layered body cornices, small corner shrine crowns and a taller central upper block with upward-curled saddle/barrel cap. Simplified brick restoration/weathering and hidden side geometry approximate.

pictures.author: Ms Sarah Welch
pictures.observations: Entire500x667 ordinary Kartikeya/southeast shrine inspected. Low rectangular weathered brick body on moulded plinth, shallow blind side projection, layered upper block and saddle-like curved cap with raised ends. Missing/eroded face details remain approximate; no speculative large tower added.

pictures.author: Ms Sarah Welch
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 ordinary mandapa-overlook picture inspected. Two rows of large surviving octagonal/tapered brick pillars with broad flat caps, two outer rows of lower posts, open sky, narrow level occupied platform and steep stair with brick cheeks between upper court and lower ruins. No restored roof. Twenty pillar stations are a picture-led allocation within the mapped rectangle, not a surveyed inventory.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Po Nagar standing complex: four mapped brick shrine envelopes with tall four-register main tower/miniature crowns, pointed south pyramid, smaller northwest stepped crown/saddle cap and low southeast saddle cap, projecting pointed entry porches/stone lintels/real recessed doors, original simplified relief/leaf/corner ornament and short local approaches. Mapped lower mandapa is an unroofed platform with approximate twenty octagonal tapered brick pillars and narrow grade-following approach steps. Existing shared brick/stone/dark-recess materials; no copied deity/story/text atlas, full ritual interior, vanished temple reconstruction or broad upper-court slab.
